authority: User $implement docs/features/core-workbench request; approved PLAN p2.6 CW-12 and fresh liveness review evidence
objective: Preserve bounded reconciliation while allowing normal large Git repository peer cwd binding.
required_corrections: For a peer cwd inside a Git worktree, build the early durable baseline from bounded Git identity plus tracked modifications, untracked files, and ignored untracked files, hashing only the bounded changed set; do not full-scan every clean tracked file.
Keep filename-output, changed-file count, per-file and total-byte limits, privacy, O_NOFOLLOW/escape protections, and fail-closed behavior for Git errors or mutation.
Retain the bounded fd-relative full-directory fallback for non-Git peer cwd.
Prove a clean Git repository exceeding 2048 entries and 64 MiB can bind/open authority, while a bounded changed set still detects post-bind out-of-scope tracked, untracked, and ignored changes.
Add focused liveness and negative tests without weakening prior scan-race coverage.
constraints: Sole product mutation owner; preserve all prior fixes and unrelated changes.
Use apply_patch; no new dependency or user-facing configuration.
Do not edit .workflow/docs/PLAN/state or other product areas; do not delegate, commit, publish, deploy, or use Docker.
Run focused/policy tests, a representative large-repo fixture, graphify update ., and report exact evidence.
report: Return changed paths, exact Git/non-Git semantics, checks/counts, large-repo evidence, candidate_ready/blocker, and residual risks.
